text: スーパー　ファミコン　だ！
note: The Super Famicom is Nintendo's 16-bit home console, released in Japan in 1990; abroad it was sold as the Super NES, which is what the English game calls it.
claim: The Super Famicom was released by Nintendo in Japan in 1990 and sold overseas as the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (Super NES).

check.quote: The Super Nintendo Entertainment System (commonly abbreviated as the SNES), known as the Super Famicom or the Super Family Computer in Japan, Taiwan, and Hong Kong, is a video game console created by Nintendo. [Infobox: Japan — November 21, 1990]
check.note: The Super Famicom is Nintendo's 16-bit home console, released in Japan in 1990; abroad it was sold as the Super NES, which is what the English game calls it.
